components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted solid CTA — light fill on dark ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #F2F2F3; color: #0A0A0C; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: filter 150ms, transform 80ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60A5FA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge — Committed
components.description: Pill badge with tinted background, solid text, and a currentColor dot.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-committed { color: #60A5FA; background: rgba(96,165,250,0.08); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Proof Card
components.description: Before/after comparison card: pill badge, status-colored ambient glow, mini bar chart, colored underline.
components.html: 2 commitments. 2 conflicts. 0 clean decisions.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #232326; background: #131316; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-glow { position: absolute; top: -40px; right: -40px; width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 9999px; filter: blur(80px); background: rgba(52,211,153,0.18); pointer-events: none; } .ds-card-headline { position: relative; font-family: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; color: #F2F2F3; }

narrative.overview: The product doesn't summarize a meeting — it reconstructs what became true after one. The surface plays that role back visually: a near-black room where a raw, unstructured transcript line resolves, in front of you, into a clean structured claim with a status and an owner. Noise on the left, order on the right; nothing is claimed that isn't shown happening. This is not a generic AI-powered gradient-hero template: no gradient text, no kicker label, no stock hero illustration. Color shows up as soft ambient light — status-red and status-green pooling behind proof cards — never as a fill inside a headline.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with soft, status-colored radial glow doing the accent work
A geometric display face (Space Grotesk) with real point of view, reserved for headlines
Every claim demonstrated live (streaming transcript to resolved status card), never just asserted
The five-state taxonomy is load-bearing brand vocabulary, not decoration

rules.name: The Glow, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Status color pools as ambient radial light behind a card or lives in a small saturated badge/dot. It never fills text, never becomes a gradient headline, never becomes a colored left-border accent.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace only renders real transcript text, real commands, or real data — never a costume on ordinary UI copy.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur only appears where it is doing a specific job, never as generic card decoration.

dos: Do keep the five-state vocabulary exact and consistent everywhere it appears.
Do ground every marketing claim in something the working tool actually produces.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for literal data/commands/transcript text.
Do use --text-disabled for tertiary captions — tuned to >=4.5:1 contrast against --bg.
donts: Don't use gradient-filled text for emphasis.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't add a colored left-border accent to a card.
Don't invent product claims, customer logos, testimonials, or metrics the working tool doesn't actually produce.
